description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'ShopProductRelationshipTag' that retrieves related products for a specific product group and stores the list in the request scope, utilizing caching for performance optimization. It interacts with services such as ProductRelationshipService and PricingService to fetch and process product relationship data.

classes.name: ShopProductRelationshipTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag for retrieving and caching related products based on a group name, used in JSP views for e-commerce product pages.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Initializes the tag, ensures dependency injection, constructs cache keys, retrieves related products from cache or database, and sets them in request scope.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Completes the tag processing, indicating page evaluation should continue.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches related products for the current product group, populates detailed product information, and returns the list.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name used for retrieving related products.

methods.name: setGroupName
methods.description: Sets the group name for related product retrieval.
